market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by subdued volume (RVOL < 0.75 across all instruments) and tight compression against session extremes or value area boundaries. Gold, Silver, EURUSD, and GBPUSD are all trading below their daily Value Area Lows and VWAP baselines, yet lack institutional volume spikes (RVOL > 2.0) needed to sustain breakdown continuations, lingering immediately above key session low supports. US100 remains damped in a positive gamma regime above its Gamma Flip, consolidating between Call Wall #1 and Prev Low resistance. BTCUSD continues to chop inside its Value Area between EMA20 and EMA50. Strict discipline warrants a complete HOLD across the portfolio until fresh session liquidity and expansion volume emerge.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (3876.49) and below POC (3882.58). CVD is BEARISH (-5.50) with negative slope (-0.70), agreeing with prevailing downward pressure. The pair is positioned in the lower half of the ATR envelope approaching the lower band (3869.08). Price is hovering immediately above S/R support at 3872.05 and the Session Low at 3867.64, presenting an unfavorable risk profile for continuation without fresh volume expansion. HOLD.

In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price sits well below falling VWAP (1.10524) and EMA50 (1.10426). Candles are hugging the lower ATR band (1.10225) while testing key Session Low support at 1.10217 (2 touches) directly beneath local S/R resistance at 1.10257. RVOL is weak at 0.662 without yellow RVOL spikes, indicating lack of institutional breakdown drive and high risk of an oversold bounce or consolidation. HOLD.

Price is trading below VAL (1.32242) and below POC (1.32338). CVD is NEUTRAL (-5252) with an upticking slope (+445.45), creating a slight bullish delta divergence against lower prices. In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price remains beneath downward-sloping VWAP (1.32298) and EMA50 (1.32228). Candles are consolidating in the lower ATR channel above the lower band (1.32030) and above Session Low support at 1.32049, with Prev Low resistance at 1.32210 overhead. RVOL is low at 0.664 with no breakout volume spikes. Given the lack of volume confirmation and divergent CVD slope, chasing continuation is unviable. HOLD.

Price is positioned below VAL (27934.23) and well below POC (28269.40). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.79) with flat slope (-0.06). In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trending below downward-sloping VWAP (28139.78) and EMA50 (28035.98). Quotations sit mid-channel near the EMA20 baseline (27909.52) well inside the ATR bands (27733.20 - 28085.83). While US100 tick volume rarely prints yellow RVOL (current RVOL 0.727), the GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with price above Gamma Flip (27858.44), where dealers dampen volatility. Price is currently wedged between Call Wall #1 (27880.41) just below and Prev Low resistance (27912.13) just above, leaving no scalp margin or directional expansion trigger. HOLD.

Price is positioned below VAL (49.455) and below POC (50.005). CVD is BEARISH (-238.65) with negative slope (-23.27), agreeing with the multi-hour downtrend. In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price remains firmly below descending VWAP (49.852) and EMA50 (49.513). Candles are pressing the lower ATR band (48.856) and retesting the triple-bottom Session Low support at 48.886. However, RVOL is only 0.718 with no yellow volume spike confirming a breakdown. Selling directly into triple-bottom Session Low support without volume expansion represents an asymmetric bear trap risk. HOLD.

Price is located inside the Value Area (VAL 68404.25 to VAH 69413.93) and above session POC (68753.75). CVD is BEARISH (-0.08) with a flat slope (+0.01), showing minimal directional force. In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trading below declining VWAP (69171.53) and capped under EMA50 (69059.74), trapped between EMA20 (68857.83) and EMA50 in a tight mid-channel consolidation. RVOL is weak at 0.561 with zero yellow spikes. Operating inside the Value Area without a breakout or POC rejection dictates a ranging/mean-reversion regime with no edge. Session Low support sits far below at 67549.90 and resistance at S/R 70156.40. HOLD.
